text:
jamie: Heads-up — starting online migration to add tenant.hash_v2 (shadow-col + backfill + swap). Window: now-45m. Deploybot queued migration `mig-2026-03-22-8` on prod-cluster-3.
deploybot: migration mig-2026-03-22-8 started. step 1/5: create shadow column (no blocking DDL).
nisha: 👍 any expected lock windows or heavy IO spikes?
jamie: Should be mostly lock-free. We stream-copy and then add constraint with CONCURRENT VERIFY pattern. Backfill is rate-capped.
liam: On staging the DDL + small sample backfill ran ~0.5s for column create and <2m for 10k rows.
deploybot: backfill progress: 12% rows processed; ETA ~22m; replication lag 0.3s.
sara: :eyes: we have the automation to pause if lag > 5s, right?
jamie: yes — there's a safety rule and manual abort: `!deploy abort mig-2026-03-22-8`. Also `!deploy pause` for graceful checkpoint.
mike: I'm seeing a long-lived lock on shard s42: process postgres pid=2345 holding a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE. A concurrent analytics compaction is running.
jamie: that's unexpected during quiet window. Is backfill hitting s42 currently?
mike: backfill cursor touched s42 ~just now, so collision likely. Compaction appears to be scheduled by nightly job at 00:28 UTC.
nisha: Options: kill compaction, or pause backfill and reschedule to next quiet window. Killing might impact analytics SLAs.
jamie: pause for safety. @deploybot pause mig-2026-03-22-8 — we want a clean checkpoint and stop processing new rows.
deploybot: migration paused by jamie at 3111112450. Checkpoint saved. Backfill stopped after processing 14% (rows processed: 1,238,412). Logs: `paused cleanly, no partial swap applied`.
liam: I'll take ownership to coordinate with analytics to shift compaction + re-run backfill in 1hr slot. Also pin the release to `v2.7.3-db` until we resume.
sara: I'll update release notes and the post-deploy checklist: "tenant.hash migration postponed due to transient shard lock; resumed -> TBC."
jamie: Agreed. Rollback criteria: if we hit the same lock on resume or see replication lag >5s persistently, we flip feature flag off and do a scheduled maintenance (no hot-run).
deploybot: Notifying #eng-oncall: migration mig-2026-03-22-8 paused and on-call alerted.
oncall: acknowledged — monitoring assigned.
jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll file a follow-up ticket with logs and plan to resume in the next quiet window (target in ~1h). If analytics can't move, we'll pick a maintenance slot with owners. Will update this thread when we've got a firm resume time.
